research.title: Classifier Calibration Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Designed controlled covariate shift experiments comparing temperature scaling and isotonic calibration across synthetic classification datasets.
Analyzed reliability diagrams, calibration error, and predictive loss to characterize sensitivity to calibration sample size and distribution mismatch.

research.title: Missing Data Mechanisms and Predictive Stability
bullets: Designed experiments comparing imputation strategies under random and feature dependent missingness in tabular classification tasks.
Analyzed variation in discrimination and calibration across missingness patterns, using repeated data splits to assess uncertainty.

research.title: Conditional Coverage of Conformal Regression Intervals
bullets: Designed experiments evaluating split conformal and conformalized quantile regression on synthetic heteroskedastic data and tabular regression benchmarks.
Analyzed interval width and empirical coverage across response noise regimes and feature subgroups to characterize conditional coverage limitations.

publications.title: Evaluating Subgroup Coverage of Conformal Regression Intervals Under Heteroskedastic Noise

projects.title: Regularized Regression with Correlated Predictors
bullets: Implemented ridge and lasso regression pipelines with standardized predictors and cross validation for penalty selection.
Compared prediction error and coefficient stability across simulated correlation structures, examining sensitivity to redundant and irrelevant predictors.

projects.title: Clustering with Gaussian Mixtures and K-Means
bullets: Implemented expectation maximization for Gaussian mixture clustering and compared assignments against a standard k-means baseline.
Evaluated clustering agreement and initialization sensitivity on synthetic datasets with overlapping groups and unequal covariance structures.

projects.title: Bootstrap Confidence Intervals for Regression Coefficients
bullets: Implemented percentile and residual bootstrap procedures for estimating uncertainty in ordinary least squares regression coefficients.
Compared empirical interval coverage and width against analytical intervals under simulated skewed errors and varying predictor distributions.
